clarification: The default NoCollision exclusion has a WITH_EDITOR exception: a world with bEnableTraceCollision and nonzero component scale may still create physics state. Thus a valid Editor-only NoCollision body does not establish that the PIE game-world volume has a body. QueryOnly explicitly requests a valid body in both contexts and remains nonblocking when every collision channel ignores.
